This has the same problem as the admin UI bundle. The account UI translates with i18next, which only interpolates `{{0}}` and cannot evaluate `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`. If this key is rendered client-side, users who submit too many or too few values get a message with the raw `{0}` placeholders and choice pattern. Keep `{{n}}` interpolation in the js bundles, or confirm the server formats this message first.
